publicationRule: Do not publish or activate until the exact WebP binary is committed, the brown involucral bracts are botanically corrected and visually reviewed, and illustration-contract plus approved-flora-browser have passed. Preserve all 23 published approvals.

items.name: Engknoppurt
items.observations: The v1 candidate illustrates solitary terminal pink-purple composite flower heads, branched upright stalks, narrow alternate stem leaves, broader lower leaves and a rooting crown. These are consistent at a general level with the taxon.
items.limitations: The brown capitulum involucral appendages are rendered too pointed and spine-like; Centaurea jacea typically shows broad, overlapping, brown, papery, irregularly lacerate appendages. The flower heads and lower leaf outlines are stylized. The generated image originally had an opaque grey checkerboard background; alpha was derived by chroma extraction and can leave edge artifacts. It must not be promoted as a botanically approved field guide image until redrawn and rechecked.
requiredRedraw: Replace pointed/scalelike bracts with rounded tan-to-dark-brown papery tips that are irregularly fringed, not spiny
Keep lilac/pink tubular florets; reduce overly radial uniformity
Verify alternating narrow upper leaves and broader undivided or shallowly toothed lower leaves
Generate genuine alpha directly or remove the gray checkerboard without edge halos
items.technicalVerification: Local 1024x1536 RGBA WebP with alpha (composited from checkerboard-backed RGB); 297494 bytes; SHA256 and Git blob SHA calculated from exact candidate bytes; compared over dark and light backgrounds.
